program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (bg 7)
                  (cr #f)
                  (cc #f)
                  (d0 (for ((r (range 0 hh)))
                        (when
                          (and (not cr) (for/and ((c (range 0 ww))) (!= (at g r c) bg)))
                          (set! cr r))))
                  (d1 (for ((c (range 0 ww)))
                        (when
                          (and (not cc) (for/and ((r (range 0 hh))) (!= (at g r c) bg)))
                          (set! cc c))))
                  (result g)
                  (d2 (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                            (when
                              (and (!= (at g r c) bg) (!= r cr) (!= c cc))
                              (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                (for ((ref (list (list r (- (* 2 cc) c))
                                              (list (- (* 2 cr) r) c)
                                              (list (- (* 2 cr) r) (- (* 2 cc) c)))))
                                  (let ((nr (first ref))
                                        (nc (second ref)))
                                    (when
                                      (and
                                        (in-bounds? nr nc hh ww)
                                        (!= nr cr)
                                        (!= nc cc))
                                      (set! result (set-cell result nr nc v))))))))))
             result))))
